services.name: Full-Time Nanny
services.tagline: Consistent daily care from a vetted nanny
services.description: A trusted, full-time caregiver who becomes part of your family's rhythm. Our nannies are background-checked, CPR-certified, and matched to your family's values and schedule. Typical placements are 20–45 hours per week.
services.bookingNotes: Minimum 20 hours/week. We recommend starting with an in-home interview and a paid trial day to make sure the fit is right.

services.name: Date Night Care
services.tagline: A reliable sitter for the nights that matter
services.description: Evening sitters who arrive on time, follow your routine, and let you actually enjoy your night out. Every date-night provider is vetted to the same standard as our full-time nannies.
services.bookingNotes: Book at least 48 hours in advance. Minimum 3-hour booking. Same-day requests subject to availability.

services.name: One-Off Care
services.description: Occasional or emergency child care — sick days, last-minute meetings, school holidays, weekend errands. The same vetted providers, scheduled in shorter blocks.
services.bookingNotes: Same-day bookings welcome but subject to availability. We'll always confirm before sending a provider.

services.name: Mother's Helper
services.tagline: Household help while you're home with the kids
services.description: An extra set of hands for the day: light tidying, laundry, meal prep, errands, and play with older children while you handle the baby or take a breath. Mother's helpers do not provide unsupervised child care.
services.bookingNotes: Booked in 3-hour blocks. Most families schedule weekly or as-needed sessions.

categories.name: Pet Sitting
categories.tagline: Loving care for the four-legged family

services.name: Drop-In Pet Visit
services.tagline: Walks, feeds, and check-ins while you're away
services.description: Scheduled visits to your home: walks, feeding, fresh water, medication, litter, and a photo update each visit. Perfect for day trips or work travel.
services.bookingNotes: Minimum 30-minute visits. Most clients book 1–3 visits per day for longer trips.

services.name: Overnight Pet Sitting
services.tagline: A trusted sitter stays with your pet while you're away
services.description: Your pet stays home, sticking to their normal routine, with one of our vetted sitters staying overnight. Includes morning and evening walks/feeds, fresh water, medication, and daily photo updates.
services.bookingNotes: Minimum 2-night booking. Book 1+ week in advance when possible.
